stories.title: Woman who spat in police officer’s face jailed for 58 weeks at Mold Crown Court
stories.summary: A woman who spat in a police officer’s face has been jailed for 58 weeks at Mold Crown Court. Kimberley Ann Evans, 31, of no fixed abode, was sentenced on 16 November after previously admitting assaulting an emergency worker, North Wales Police said. stories.title: SP Energy Networks says power has been restored in Lixwm
stories.summary: Update, 13:50 20 Nov: SP Energy Networks says power has been restored. Earlier report: Part of Lixwm is without power this afternoon after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 4.16pm. The fault was reported at 12.01pm and affects five postcodes: CH8 8NQ, CH8 8NF, CH8 8ND, CH8 8LX

stories.title: Traffic Officers across North Wales now carry defibrillators after charity donation
stories.summary: Save a Life Cymru has donated 16 defibrillators to Traffic Wales, with half going to officers who patrol the main routes through Flintshire.

stories.title: Motorcyclist taken to hospital after collision on A541 at Afonwen near Mold
stories.summary: The A541 at Afonwen, near Mold, has reopened after a collision between a car and a motorcycle this morning. The motorcyclist was taken to hospital by road, North Wales Police said.
